verdict.rationale: Docs mention that deployments 'support stable environments for development, staging, and production' (baseten-docs-20) and that Truss models 'behave the same in development and production' (baseten-gh-1), implying separate non-prod environments exist. However there is no detailed documentation of how sandbox/staging is isolated from production data, no guidance on seeding test data, and no independent confirmation of this workflow. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging setup guide, data-isolation guarantees, and hands-on/community corroboration of safe non-prod testing.
